wed.title: Wednesday
wed.warm: Elliptical + band pull-aparts + a few light lat-pulldown activation sets

prog.t: Maintenance day · back had no soreness this week. No soreness on a maintenance muscle = room to progress load, so we keep climbing. Two machines jump too coarse — for Lat Pulldown bank all your reps at 145 before the ugly 15-lb jump to 160; for Hammer Row we add a 5-lb microplate so you get 85/side instead of being stuck at 80→90. Pronated grip locked on the row (upper-back thickness — your other back work is neutral). Wide-grip bar curl stays for the outer head.

e: 145 clean, then 160 was a stretch (~9–10) — the jump's too big · HOLD 145 and bank all 12 reps on every set first; only jump to 160 once 145×12 is clean across all 4 · train to failure · same machine each week
